page_title: VAL 1-1 BET | Valencia v Betis 09/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Chimy Avila (Betis) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
90+5' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
90+4' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
90+2' Manuel Pellegrini prepares a substitution. Cucho Hernandez is replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
90+1' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

90' A pass travels right across the box to Cucho Hernandez (Betis) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Julen Agirrezabala denies him with a decent save.
88' Valencia are seeing far more of the ball now.
86' Valentin Gomez (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Victor Garcia had an easy-decision to make.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
85' The attendance for today's match is 45820.
84' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
82' 1 - 1 Goal! Luis Rioja (Valencia) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
82' The linesman points to the corner flag, Valencia are going to take it.
82' Luis Rioja (Valencia) takes the corner but it's cleared.
81' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Valencia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 9:8.
77' Substitution. Pepelu will be replaced by Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia).
77' It's time for a substitution. Jesus Vazquez (Valencia) comes on in place of Jose Gaya.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Dani Raba (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Andre Almeida.
76' Substitution. Giovani Lo Celso is replaced by Marc Roca (Betis).
76' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli makes way for Rodrigo Riquelme (Betis).
76' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is punished with the yellow card.
76' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is the one who receives a yellow card.
74' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Cucho Hernandez (Betis), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
73' That was close. Antony (Betis) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
72' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.
71' Some patient build-up play from Valencia as they look to unlock the defence.
69' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Pepelu (Valencia) is given a yellow card.
69' Luis Rioja (Valencia) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
69' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Valencia earn a corner.
68' Substitution. Luis Rioja (Valencia) in, Diego Lopez out.
68' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Lucas Beltran will be replaced by Hugo Duro (Valencia).
68' Javi Guerra (Valencia) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall charges down the ball. Valencia win a corner.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Natan (Betis) was quite harsh and Victor Garcia didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
66' 10:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
64' Thierry Correia (Valencia) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
62' Lucas Beltran (Valencia) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
60' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Valencia was in an offside position.
58' Valentin Gomez (Betis) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
56' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
55' Golden chance! Antony (Betis) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
54' The ball possession is 40:60.

52' Diego Lopez (Valencia) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
50' Antony (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Julen Agirrezabala comes off his line to gather the ball.
48' Valencia keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.

45' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
43' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 5:5.
41' Pepelu (Valencia) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
40' Pablo Fornals (Betis) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Andre Almeida (Valencia) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the middle of the goal, but Alvaro Valles keeps it out with an amazing save.
35' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pablo Fornals (Betis).
33' A spell of possession for Betis in an attempt to control the game.
31' 4:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
28' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
26' Andre Almeida (Valencia) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
24' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Jose Gaya (Valencia) for his blatant foul.
22' Valencia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
20' What a huge chance for Javi Guerra (Valencia). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
17' Valencia are showing great team-chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly but finally one of the defending players makes an interception.
14' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Valentin Gomez (Betis) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
13' 52:48 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
11' Some neat passing and movement from Betis as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.

9' What a sweet touch by Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) after latching on to a fine pass on the edge of the box! He finds some space and unleashes a cannonball towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper makes a brilliant save, pushing the ball onto the post.
7' The game is interrupted. Andre Almeida (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
5' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
4' A pass into the box finds Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) unmarked. He carefully places a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Alvaro Valles denies him.
3' Some great controlled play and passing from Valencia. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will supervise the game today.
